content.snl: variable(__list__(Type.annotation(@$\mathbb{K}$,Type),Type.annotation(@V,Type),LA.Field($\mathbb{K}$),LA.VectorSpace(V,$\mathbb{K}$),Type.annotation(@u1,V),Type.annotation(@u2,V),Type.annotation(@v,V),Type.annotation(@k,$\mathbb{K}$)),theorem($(u_1+u_2) \wedge v = u_1 \wedge v + u_2 \wedge v \quad\text{and}\quad (k\,u) \wedge v = k\,(u \wedge v)$))

values.zh-CN: 楔积对每个变量分别可加、齐次：$(u_1+u_2)\wedge v=u_1\wedge v+u_2\wedge v$，$(ku)\wedge v=k(u\wedge v)$；所有运算都在外幂 $\bigwedge^{2}_{\mathbb{K}}V$ 中进行。
values.en: The wedge is additive and homogeneous in each variable: $(u_1+u_2)\wedge v=u_1\wedge v+u_2\wedge v$ and $(ku)\wedge v=k(u\wedge v)$, all operations taken in the exterior power $\bigwedge^{2}_{\mathbb{K}}V$.
